calibration_source: frozen 05c held-out behavior-diverse A/B test queries
selection_rule: eligible iff A support >=0.70, D support <=0.30, A-vs-D AUROC >=0.80; highest AUROC then lower D support then higher A support
next_if_selected: freeze selected score and threshold rule, implement support-aware replay, then evaluate only held-out seeds 2/3 under ABA and ABD
next_if_none_selected: do not touch held-out seeds 2/3; reconsider support formulation
